paragraphs.en: A Router that separates channel-error states from a reference population establishes READABLE and nothing further. In the layer analysis reported in the main text, Router discrimination stays near-constant across a range of observation layers while the correction direction estimated at those same layers degrades from usable to noise. High Router AUC is therefore evidence that the state is decodable at that site, not that intervening there will help.
paragraphs.zh: 一个将信道错误状态与参考种群分离的路由器，仅能建立可读性，除此之外别无他物。 在正文中报告的层分析中，路由器的区分能力在不同观测层范围内基本保持恒定，而同一层中估计的校正方向则从可用退化为噪声。 因此，高路由器 AUC 表明该状态在该位置是可解码的，而非意味着干预该位置会有所帮助。

paragraphs.en: For one input and one candidate mode the scored quantity is the mean over that candidate’s token positions of the log-probability the model assigns to them. Its gradient is taken with respect to the MLP forward output at ℓ inj \ell_{\mathrm{inj}} — the same tensor the intervention later modifies — and reduced to a vector by summing over sequence positions, which gives G i , m G_{i,m} . The inner normalisation above makes the outer mean an average of directions rather than of magnitudes, so no single large-gradient row dominates it. Nothing inside the estimator is optimised, weighted, filtered or searched: there is no layer search, sign search, sample selection or dose tuning. The difference-in-means comparator follows the opposite subtraction by construction, mean correct-reference activation minus mean channel-error activation, so that both directions point from the error state toward the required action.
paragraphs.zh: 对于单个输入和单个候选模式，得分量是该模型分配给该候选模式各标记位置的对数概率在这些位置上的平均值。 其梯度是相对于 ℓ inj \ell_{\mathrm{inj}} 处的 MLP 前向输出计算的——也就是后续干预所修改的同一张张量——并通过对各序列位置求和将其简化为一个向量，从而得到 G i , m G_{i,m}。 上述内部归一化使得外部平均值成为方向的平均而非大小的平均，因此没有单个梯度较大的行会主导该平均值。 估计器内部没有任何内容被优化、加权、过滤或搜索：不存在层搜索、符号搜索、样本选择或剂量调整。 均值差比较器在构造上遵循相反的减法操作，即正确参考激活的均值减去通道错误激活的均值，这样两个方向都从错误状态指向所需动作。

paragraphs.en: Each sealed setting is adjudicated by the ten conditions of Table 7 , written in the Qwen3-8B preregistration before the first sealed evaluation and applied unchanged to all three settings. The gate has a deliberate symmetry: every scientific quantity it uses is tested twice, once at its point estimate and once at the edge of its 95 % 95\% interval. Destination therefore contributes four conditions and preservation two; the remaining four are integrity and specificity checks that are not about effect size at all. Two of the four destination conditions are not independent at the point estimate: since TG c = ( X c / N c ) ​ ( 2 ​ TH c − 1 ) \mathrm{TG}_{c}=(X_{c}/N_{c})(2\,\mathrm{TH}_{c}-1) , when X c > 0 X_{c}>0 the conditions TG c > 0 \mathrm{TG}_{c}>0 and TH c > 0.50 \mathrm{TH}_{c}>0.50 are algebraically equivalent. They are retained as separate numbered conditions because the freeze numbered them so, and because the two quantities carry different information — TG c \mathrm{TG}_{c} retains coverage over N c N_{c} , TH c \mathrm{TH}_{c} the destination composition over X c X_{c} — but they are not two independent pieces of positive evidence, and their interval versions, Conditions 3 and 6, are not equivalent.

paragraphs.en: A natural objection is that the ten conditions are more apparatus than the evidence requires: perhaps a simpler reporting rule would reach the same conclusions. Figure 7 answers this directly by replaying every evaluated unit — sealed, historical and development alike — against eight alternative reporting rules, from “Net gain above zero” to the full frozen conjunction. The sequence is not a nested tightening: R4 drops the specificity requirement rather than adding to it. paragraphs.en: Two conditions would replace Conditions 7 and 8: a one-sided 95 % 95\% upper bound on E2 \mathrm{E2} below ϵ tol = 0.05 \epsilon_{\mathrm{tol}}=0.05 — one-sided rather than bootstrap, because the bootstrap bound is degenerate whenever no break is observed (Appendix O ) — and a minimum exposure | C exp | |C_{\mathrm{exp}}| large enough for that bound to be attainable. paragraphs.en: Two further conditions are absent from the frozen conjunction and belong in any successor to it. The first is coverage: TH c \mathrm{TH}_{c} is computed over source exits, so it says nothing about how much of the channel was reached, and a gate written on it alone rewards a Router that fires rarely on easy rows. A successor should condition on Router recall over N c N_{c} and on gold arrivals over N c N_{c} rather than over X c X_{c} ; on the three sealed settings those arrival shares are 0.437 0.437 , 0.298 0.298 and 0.177 0.177 . The second is effect size: Condition 2 asks only TG c > 0 \mathrm{TG}_{c}>0 , which licenses an arbitrarily small positive gain provided its interval clears zero, where a threshold tied to what a deployment would find worth the collateral risk would be a stronger rule than a sign test. We add neither here: both would have to be fixed before evaluation to mean anything, and the evaluation is already spent.
paragraphs.zh: 冰冻联合中缺少另外两个条件，而这两个条件应属于其任何后续结构。 第一个是覆盖范围：TH c \mathrm{TH}_{c} 是基于源出口计算的，因此它并未说明通道被覆盖的程度；仅基于该结构设计的门控机制会奖励那些在简单行上很少触发的路由器。 后续结构应以 N c N_{c} 范围内路由器的召回率以及 N c N_{c} 范围内的黄金到达率为条件，而非 X c X_{c} 范围内的数据；在三种密封设置中，这些到达份额分别为 0.437、0.298 和 0.177。 第二个是效应大小：条件 2 仅要求 TG c > 0 \mathrm{TG}_{c}>0，这允许任意小的正增益，只要其区间不包含零；而一个与部署中值得承担附带风险的阈值相关的规则，会比单纯的符号检验更具约束力。 我们在此并未添加这两项：两者都必须在评估前固定下来才能有意义，而评估过程本身已经执行完毕。

It is not a deployment-safety claim: the preservation conditions the gate uses are computed on E1, the population denominator, and a setting may pass them while leaving the exposure-conditional rate unbounded (Appendix H ).

paragraphs.en: A DECLINE states that the evidence is insufficient for the stronger claim under the evaluated protocol and the available sample support. paragraphs.en: The primary benchmark. Each input offers four candidate responses, one per pre-execution action mode. Three of the four occur as reference labels; answering directly appears only as a distractor. Labels are synthetically generated and automatically assigned by the benchmark’s authors, and we did not re-annotate them (see Appendix Q for what this limits). A decision is read out by teacher-forced scoring of the four complete candidates, and the predicted action is the highest-scoring one; the readout is frozen and deterministic, so a baseline run and an intervened run differ only through the intervention. The 3,652 3{,}652 items are split 2,556 2{,}556 / 548 548 / 548 548 into training, validation and locked test.
paragraphs.zh: 主要基准测试。 每个输入提供四个候选响应，每个预执行动作模式对应一个。 四个响应中有三个作为参考标签出现；直接回答仅作为干扰项出现。 标签由基准测试的作者通过合成方式生成并自动分配，我们未对其进行重新标注（关于此做法的限制，请参见附录 Q）。 决策通过教师强制评分机制对四个完整候选项进行评分得出，预测动作是得分最高的选项；该评分过程是固定且确定性的，因此基线运行与干预运行仅因干预本身而不同。 3,652 个样本被划分为 2,556 / 548 / 548 份训练集、验证集和锁定测试集。

paragraphs.en: Used in its binary form for one model, where the only choice is whether to call a tool. paragraphs.en: What failed was the channel structure, not the instrument. No directional transition met the preregistered per-split support minimum, and a paraphrase-agreement check required before channel discovery returned 0.56 0.56 against a threshold of 0.80 0.80 . Because 136 136 of the 137 137 native-label errors trace to the official parse rules, the failure localises to the benchmark’s size and wording sensitivity. Under the locked decision rule this retires ACEBench from the intervention line: we report no correction, no destination and no licence outcome for it. Two qualifications belong with that verdict — the parser figure is a point estimate on 102 102 rows whose stratification is undocumented, and the paraphrase reformulation is recorded in our own audit as carrying a weaker format directive than the original, so the 0.56 0.56 is not clean evidence of wording fragility.
paragraphs.zh: 失败的是通道结构，而非工具本身。 没有任何方向性转换达到预先登记的每次分割支持最小值，且通道发现前所需的改写一致性检查结果显示为 0.56 0.56，低于 0.80 0.80 的阈值。 由于 137 个原生标签错误中有 136 个可追溯至官方解析规则，因此失败原因可归因于基准测试的规模及其对措辞的敏感性。 根据锁定决策规则，ACEBench 将不再纳入干预流程：我们对其报告无修正、无目的地且无许可结果。 这一结论有两个限定条件——解析器数据是基于 102 行样本的点估计，且其分层情况未作记录；此外，改写后的表述在我们自己的审计中被记录为格式指令弱于原文，因此 0.56 这一数值并非措辞脆弱性的明确证据。

paragraphs.en: Baseline predictions were collected and the confusion topology enumerated; the channel cannot_answer → \rightarrow tool_call was selected and the selection disclosed; the direction was estimated on training rows only and hashed; the Router and threshold were fitted on training and validation; the dose was calibrated on development data under the min(admissible) rule; the runner, configuration, direction hashes and random seeds were frozen and a gate-only pass verified them without opening the evaluation payload; an access marker was written; the formal run executed once; endpoints were computed after the zero-arm exactness gate passed.
paragraphs.zh: 收集了基线预测并枚举了混淆拓扑；选择了 channel_CANNOT_ANSWER → \rightarrow TOOL_CALL 并披露了该选择；仅基于训练行估算了方向并进行了哈希处理；在训练和验证数据上拟合了路由器和阈值；在开发数据上根据 min(admissible) 规则校准了剂量；冻结了运行器、配置、方向哈希和随机种子，并通过仅执行门控验证了它们，而未打开评估负载；写入了一个访问标记；正式运行执行了一次；在零臂精确性门通过之后计算了端点。

paragraphs.en: All ten conditions passed and the frozen verdict is FORMAL_CONFIRMATORY_SUCCESS . None of the 59 59 budget-matched random directions reached the real direction’s target gain; the largest random target gain was 0.0230 0.0230 against the real 0.2759 0.2759 , giving an add-one p p of 0.0167 0.0167 . The zero arm reproduced the baseline exactly, the reversed direction moved at most one channel error off its source, and the same direction injected at ℓ = 26 \ell=26 reached a target gain of 0.0575 0.0575 .
paragraphs.zh: 所有十个条件均通过，最终判定为 FORMAL_CONFIRMATORY_SUCCESS。 在 59 个预算匹配的随机方向中，没有一个达到了真实方向的收益目标；最大的随机目标收益为 0.0230，而真实收益为 0.2759，由此得出的加一 p 值为 0.0167。 零臂完全复现了基线，反向移动最多仅偏离其源通道一个错误，而在 ℓ = 26 处注入相同方向时，则达到了 0.0575 的目标收益。

sents.en: The zero arm reproduced the baseline exactly, the reversed direction moved at most one channel error off its source, and the same direction injected at ℓ = 26 \ell=26 reached a target gain of 0.0575 0.0575 .
sents.zh: 零臂完全复现了基线，反向移动最多仅偏离其源通道一个错误，而在 ℓ = 26 处注入相同方向时，则达到了 0.0575 的目标收益。

paragraphs.en: Preservation passes on E1 — zero breaks among all 211 211 baseline-correct decisions, one-sided upper bound 0.0141 0.0141 — but the Router exposed only six correct decisions, so the exposure-conditional bound is 0.3930 0.3930 and E2 is vacuous as evidence of preservation. The statement this setting supports is that no collateral damage was observed in the population, not that the intervention is safe on the decisions it touches. This qualifier belongs to the claim and is not separable from it.
paragraphs.zh: 保护性机制在 E1 中得以延续——在所有 211 个经过基线校正的决定中，没有发生任何中断，单侧上界为 0.0141——但路由器仅暴露了六个正确的决定，因此条件于暴露的上界为 0.3930，而 E2 作为保护性机制的证据则显得空洞。 该设置所支持的说法是，在总体中未观察到任何附带损害，而非意味着干预措施在其影响到的决定上是安全的。 这一限定语属于该主张本身，且无法与其分离。

paragraphs.en: This setting is a formal adjudication, not a failed experiment. The intervention produced directional movement that survived every specificity control, and every point estimate cleared its threshold. The gate declined it on the precision of the destination evidence alone.
paragraphs.zh: 这一设定是一项正式裁决，而非一次失败的实验。 该干预措施产生了方向性变化，这种变化通过了所有特异性控制，且每个点估计值都超过了其阈值。 仅凭目的地证据的精确度，该机制就拒绝了它。

paragraphs.en: Of 124 124 channel errors, 118 118 were routed. The intervention produced 64 64 source exits, of which 37 37 reached the required action and 27 27 landed on a third wrong action, giving TH c = 0.5781 \mathrm{TH}_{c}=0.5781 over exits and TG c = 10 / 124 = 0.081 \mathrm{TG}_{c}=10/124=0.081 over all channel errors. Fixed and Broke were 40 40 and 1 1 , a Net of + 39 +39 on the whole population and + 36 +36 at channel level. The Router exposed 50 50 correct decisions and broke one of them, so E2 is 1 / 50 1/50 with a one-sided upper bound of 0.0914 0.0914 ; the population rate E1 passed both its point and interval conditions. The frozen collateral audit quantifies why that pass is weak evidence: 164 164 of the 214 214 rows in the frozen denominator, 76.6 % 76.6\% , were never perturbed at all, so the gate’s own metric is diluted by the rows the Router declined. The audit records the exposure-conditional rate beside it as a required diagnostic disclosure rather than as the frozen metric, and carries a claim lock stating that passing the formal collateral endpoint must not be read as demonstrated deployment safety. That lock is the reason this paper reports both denominators. None of the 59 59 budget-matched random directions reached the real target gain — the largest was 0.0000 0.0000 — for an add-one p p of 0.0167 0.0167 .
paragraphs.zh: 在 124 个通道错误中，有 118 个被路由。 该干预措施产生了 64 个源出口，其中 37 个达到了所需操作，27 个则执行了第三个错误操作，因此出口总体的 TH c = 0.5781 \mathrm{TH}_{c}=0.5781，所有通道错误的 TG c = 10 / 124 = 0.081 \mathrm{TG}_{c}=10/124=0.081。 固定和破坏的数量分别为 40 和 1，整个群体中净增 +39，通道层面净增 +36。 路由器暴露了 50 个正确决策，并破坏了其中一个，因此 E2 为 1 / 50，单侧上界为 0.0914；群体比率 E1 通过了其点估计和区间条件。 冻结的附带审计量化了为何这一通过是弱证据：在冻结分母中的 214 行里，有 164 行（76.6%）从未受到任何扰动，因此路由器的拒绝行为稀释了该机制自身的指标。 审计记录将暴露条件比率作为必要的诊断披露信息并列示，而非作为冻结指标，并附加一项声明锁定：通过正式的附带终点不应被解读为已证明的部署安全性。 正是由于这一锁定，本文才会报告两个分母。 在 59 个预算匹配的随机方向中，没有哪一个达到了真正的目标增益——最大值仅为 0.0000——因此加一 p 为 0.0167。

paragraphs.en: The named control arms separate cleanly here, and we report them because the same battery on Qwen3-8B is quoted only in prose. Against the real arm’s TG c = 0.081 \mathrm{TG}_{c}=0.081 over 64 64 exits, the zero arm reproduced the baseline exactly and the reversed direction moved no decision off its source at all ( 0 0 exits). Both misallocations are negative rather than merely weaker: the frozen DiffMean estimator reaches TG c = − 0.016 \mathrm{TG}_{c}=-0.016 on 4 4 exits, and the wrong-layer arm − 0.024 -0.024 on 15 15 . Removing the Router leaves arrivals unchanged at 37 37 but raises breaks from 1 1 to 6 6 , so gating buys a six-fold reduction in collateral at no cost in arrivals. The score-space comparator is the one arm not dominated, and it is the clearest illustration in the paper of why the two axes must be read together: it reaches a higher target gain ( 0.105 0.105 , 44 44 arrivals) and breaks 6 6 exposed decisions against the activation arm’s 1 1 . Neither arm is better on both axes at once, which is precisely the situation an aggregate would collapse and a destination-resolved account keeps visible. We report the contrast and claim no ordering between them.
paragraphs.zh: 命名控制臂在此处清晰分离，我们报告它们是因为 Qwen3-8B 上的同一电池仅在正文中被引用。 在 64 个出口中，真实臂的 TG c = 0.081 \mathrm{TG}_{c}=0.081；零臂完全复现了基线，而反向臂则完全没有偏离其源决策（0 个出口）。 这两种误分配都是负值，而不仅仅是较弱：冻结的 DiffMean 估计器在 4 个出口上达到 TG c = − 0.016 \mathrm{TG}_{c}=-0.016，而错误层臂则在 15 个出口上达到 − 0.024。 移除路由器后，到达数保持不变（37），但中断数从 1 增加到 6，因此门控机制无需牺牲任何到达数即可将附带损失减少六倍。 分数空间比较器是唯一未被支配的臂，也是论文中最清晰地说明为何必须同时解读两个轴的例子：它达到了更高的目标增益（0.105，44 个到达），并在激活臂的 1 次中断中实现了 6 次暴露决策的中断。 没有任何一个臂能同时在两个轴上更优，这正是聚合模型会坍缩、而目的地解析账户却能保持可见的情况。 我们报告了这种对比，但并未对两者进行排序。

paragraphs.en: This outcome is the clearest demonstration in the paper that the licensing rule changes the scientific conclusion. A reporting standard based on aggregate gain would not distinguish these two settings at all: + 40 +40 against + 39 +39 , a difference of one decision. A standard that added specificity would still admit both, since both clear the K = 59 K=59 null. What separates them is the width of the destination evidence at the sample sizes available, and Appendix O shows that the declines are what those sample sizes predict.
paragraphs.zh: 这一结果是在论文中最清晰的证明，表明许可规则改变了科学结论。 基于总收益的报告标准完全无法区分这两种情况：+40 +40 与 +39 +39，仅相差一个决策。 即使采用更具具体性的标准，两者仍都会被接受，因为两者都通过了 K = 59 K=59 的零假设检验。 区分它们的关键在于可用样本量下目标证据的宽度，而附录 O 表明，这种下降正是这些样本量所预测的结果。

paragraphs.en: The four historical settings developed the framework and are reported under the protocol generation that produced them; Figure 8 shows the two whose control batteries survive in full. They receive no formal verdict: the sealed gate was written afterwards and was never run on them. Applying its criteria to their recorded counts is a retrospective reading, and we label it as such wherever it appears.
paragraphs.zh: 这四种历史设定构建了该框架，并在生成它们的协议中有所记载；图 8 展示了其中两种其控制电池得以完整保留的设定。 它们并未获得任何正式判定：那扇密封的大门是后来才被写下的，也从未在它们上运行过。 将标准应用于它们记录的数据是一种事后解读，因此我们在所有出现该解读的地方都明确标注了这一点。

paragraphs.en: The only historical setting with surviving row-level records, and therefore the only one whose destination composition can be resolved. Under the locked configuration at seed 42 42 the Router fired on 293 293 decisions, comprising 200 200 channel errors and 93 93 baseline-correct decisions. Of the 200 200 errors, 47 47 retained their source and 153 153 left it; of those exits, 107 107 reached the required action and 46 46 landed on a third wrong action, for TH = 107 / 153 = 0.6993 \mathrm{TH}=107/153=0.6993 . Of the 93 93 exposed correct decisions, 41 41 survived and 52 52 were broken.
paragraphs.zh: 这是唯一保留有行级记录的历史场景，因此也是唯一一个能够确定其最终构成比例的案例。 在种子为 42 42 的锁定配置下，路由器对 293 293 个决策进行了处理，其中包括 200 200 个通道错误和 93 93 个基准正确的决策。 在这 200 200 个错误中，有 47 47 个保留了其来源，153 153 个则离开了来源；在这些离开的案例中，107 107 个达到了所需操作，46 46 个则落到了第三个错误操作上，因此 TH = 107 / 153 = 0.6993 \mathrm{TH}=107/153=0.6993。 在 93 93 个暴露出的正确决策中，有 41 41 个得以保留，52 52 个则被破坏。

paragraphs.en: Two qualifications are required. Both results rest on secondary audit records rather than on primary row-level artifacts, and both are flagged in those records as estimator-suspect and compared against 20 20 random directions rather than the 59 59 of the sealed protocol. The conclusion these settings support is therefore that, under the evaluated configuration, estimator and site, there is insufficient evidence that the correction is caused by the recovered direction. paragraphs.en: The construction is recorded in full and is reproducible from the manifest alone: for each i < K i<K the seed is the first eight bytes of SHA256 ( salt ∥ i ) \mathrm{SHA256}(\text{salt}\,\|\,i) , a PCG64DXSM generator draws z ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , I ) z\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I) in float64, the vector is normalised in float64 and cast once to float32. The manifest also records, per vector, the seed input, the seed digest and the vector digest, so any reader can regenerate the set and check it against the frozen hashes. Four exclusions are asserted in the same record and are what make the null a null: no rejection sampling, no orthogonalisation, no cosine filtering and no outcome matching, with no regeneration and no post-hoc selection. The cosines quoted above were computed after the complete set was frozen, and no vector was removed on their basis.
paragraphs.zh: 该构造过程已完整记录，仅凭清单即可重现：对于每个 i < K i<K，种子为 SHA256 (salt ∥ i) \mathrm{SHA256}(\text{salt}\,\|\,i) 的前八个字节，一个 PCG64DXSM 生成器生成 z ∼ 𝒩⁡(0,I) z\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I)（浮点64格式），随后将向量归一化为浮点64格式，并一次性转换为浮点32格式。 因此，该零向量是出于构造本身的各向同性，而非通过检验得出的结论。 清单还记录了每个向量的种子输入、种子摘要和向量摘要，因此任何读取者都可以重新生成该集合，并将其与已冻结的哈希值进行比对验证。 同一记录中声明了四项排除项，正是这些排除项使零向量成为真正的零向量：不采用拒绝采样、不执行正交化、不使用余弦过滤，也不进行结果匹配，且不存在再生或事后选择。 上述引用的余弦值是在整个集合被冻结后计算的，没有任何向量基于这些余弦值被移除。

paragraphs.en: Removing the gate changes the outcome, but not uniformly, and we describe it only by its measured effects. On Phi-3.5 an ungated arm reverses the sign of the effect within an independent execution of the locked configuration, from + 62 +62 to − 32 -32 ; on both MetaTool channels the ungated arms fall to − 39 -39 and − 34 -34 ; on Qwen3-8B the ungated Net drops from + 38 +38 to + 13 +13 while its collateral rises from 0 / 6 0/6 to 29 / 176 = 16.5 % 29/176=16.5\% . On Gemma-2-9B the ungated arm is a genuine counterexample: its Net is not lower but marginally higher ( + 16 +16 gated against + 17 +17 ungated), and its collateral rate is lower rather than higher ( 4 / 188 = 2.1 % 4/188=2.1\% ungated against 1 / 11 = 9.1 % 1/11=9.1\% gated), though a single break on eleven exposed rows makes that rate comparison unstable, which is why we state the counterexample on Net where it is unambiguous. The five settings with both a gated and an ungated arm are Phi-3.5, the two MetaTool channels taken together, Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen3-8B and Gemma-2-9B, and Net is the only endpoint recorded for every one of them. Read on Net, gating raises the effect in three of the five — Phi-3.5, MetaTool and Qwen3-8B — and lowers it in two, on Qwen2.5-7B by + 79 +79 against + 94 +94 and on Gemma-2-9B by + 16 +16 against + 17 +17 . We therefore make no necessity claim on Net. Arrivals per broken decision and collateral rate order the arms differently in places, and we do not substitute one for another. On Qwen2.5-7B the ungated arm reaches a larger Net ( + 94 +94 against + 79 +79 ) by acting on 293 293 decisions instead of 202 202 and absorbing more damage. What gating raises consistently, in the three settings where both arms are directly comparable, is the number of arrivals per broken decision: from 5.27 5.27 to 7.08 7.08 on Qwen2.5-7B, from 5.25 5.25 to 17.00 17.00 on Gemma-2-9B, and from 1.45 1.45 on Qwen3-8B to a gated arm that breaks nothing.
paragraphs.zh: 移除门控会改变结果，但并非均匀改变，我们仅通过其测量到的效应来描述这种变化。 在 Phi-3.5 上，无门控分支在独立执行的锁定配置中使效应符号反转，从 +62 +62 变为 −32 -32；在两个 MetaTool 通道上，无门控分支的结果降至 −39 -39 和 −34 -34；在 Qwen3-8B 上，无门控的 Net 从 +38 +38 降至 +13 +13，而其附带效应则从 0 / 6 0/6 升至 29 / 176 = 16.5% 29/176=16.5\%。 在 Gemma-2-9B 上，无门控分支是一个真正的反例：其 Net 并未降低，反而略高（门控为 +16 +16，无门控为 +17 +17），且其附带率较低而非较高（无门控为 4 / 188 = 2.1% 4/188=2.1\%，门控为 1 / 11 = 9.1% 1/11=9.1\%）；尽管在十一个暴露行中仅一次中断就使这一附带率比较变得不稳定，因此我们在 Net 上指出该反例，因为此处结果明确无误。 同时具有门控和无门控分支的五个设置是 Phi-3.5、两个 MetaTool 通道（合并计算）、Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3-8B 和 Gemma-2-9B，且 Net 是它们每一个中唯一记录的结果指标。 从 Net 上的结果来看，在五个设置中的三个（Phi-3.5、MetaTool 和 Qwen3-8B），门控提升了效应；而在另外两个设置中则降低了效应：Qwen2.5-7B 的效应从 +94 +94 降至 +79 +79，Gemma-2-9B 的效应从 +17 +17 降至 +16 +16。 因此，我们对 Net 并不提出任何必要性主张。 每次中断决策的到达次数和附带率在某些情况下对分支的排序不同，我们不会用其中一个指标替代另一个。 在 Qwen2.5-7B 上，无门控分支通过作用于 293 个决策（而非 202 个）并承受更多损失，获得了更高的 Net（+94 +94 对比 +79 +79）。 在三个两个分支均可直接比较的设置中，门控一致提升的是每次中断决策的到达次数：Qwen2.5-7B 从 5.27 增至 7.08，Gemma-2-9B 从 5.25 增至 17.00，而 Qwen3-8B 则从 1.45 提升至门控分支完全不中断的情况。

paragraphs.en: Net is not a wrong statistic. It is the right statistic for the question “did accuracy improve”, and on that question it is exact. The claim of this paper is narrower: Net is a many-to-one compression of the five-class flow in equation 6 , and the classes it discards are the ones a repair claim depends on.

paragraphs.en: A study reporting only the aggregate would have treated these two interventions as interchangeable: + 40 +40 against + 39 +39 . Resolved by destination they differ by seven decisions redistributed to a third wrong action. The paired comparisons are exact McNemar p = 1.0 p=1.0 for arrivals and p = 0.189 p=0.189 for redistributions, and the archived artifact records that all-548 paired correctness was not prespecified as a paired comparison. We therefore report the contrast and draw no superiority claim in either direction.
paragraphs.zh: 如果一项研究仅报告汇总结果，那么它将把这两种干预措施视为可互换的：+40 +40 对 +39 +39。 按最终结果区分，两者相差七项决策，这些决策被重新分配到了第三个错误行动中。 配对比较的结果完全符合 McNemar 检验：抵达情况为 p = 1.0 p=1.0，重新分配情况为 p = 0.189 p=0.189；存档的实证记录表明，所有 548 个配对的正确性并未被预先指定为配对比较。 因此，我们报告了这一差异，但并未声称任何一方具有优势。

paragraphs.en: Decoupled Dynamics Across Probing, Geometry, Gating, and Dosage. The analyses in this subsection are a preregistered follow-up and are exploratory: they are not part of the frozen conjunction, and they locate no component. Mechanistic analyses on Qwen2.5-7B and prospective cohorts demonstrate sharp dissociations between representation decoding and intervention efficacy. Across layers 16–22 of Qwen2.5-7B, linear probe decodability plateaus at AUROC ≈ 0.96 \text{AUROC}\approx 0.96 , yet steering vector norms scale non-linearly ( 2.12 → 14.26 2.12\rightarrow 14.26 ) and validation net gain jumps from + 13 +13 at layer 16 to + 46 +46 at layer 20, where layer 16 steering fails due to near-zero PC1 alignment. Across geometric formulations, PCA extraction outperforms difference-in-means ( + 50 +50 vs. + 36 +36 locked net gain), while cross-channel injections produce severe negative performance ( − 17 -17 net gain on Phi-3.5-mini); the channels are related but not interchangeable, with pairwise cosines of 0.488 0.488 , 0.569 0.569 and 0.706 0.706 between Qwen2.5-7B’s three When2Call directions measured at a common layer. Ablating router gating triggers catastrophic degradation on unconstrained runs, causing net gains to flip negative on Phi-3.5-mini ( + 62 → − 32 +62\rightarrow-32 ) and MetaTool ( − 39 -39 and − 34 -34 ); conversely, gating sharpens precision, reducing breaks from 6 to 1 on Qwen3-4B while holding arrivals constant at 37. Read on Net, gating is not uniformly necessary: it raises Net on Phi-3.5, MetaTool and Qwen3-8B, and lowers it on Qwen2.5-7B ( + 79 +79 gated against + 94 +94 ungated) and marginally on Gemma-2-9B ( + 16 +16 against + 17 +17 ), so the effect on Net is setting-dependent. What gating changes consistently is exposure and the collateral that follows from it. Finally, dose-response curves on Qwen3-4B reveal non-monotonic scaling, where target-hit rates span 0.525 0.525 to 0.911 0.911 across dosage regimes, peaking at intermediate injection magnitudes before regressing.

paragraphs.en: The Multi-Dimensional Architecture of Latent Steering. These mechanistic investigations reveal that representation decodability does not entail causal steerability: the internal layers that maximally linearly separate error states are not necessarily the computational sites where interventions effectively shift downstream decisions. Furthermore, the sensitivity of outcomes to extraction geometry and injection dosage demonstrates that causal steering acts within specific, multi-dimensional subspaces rather than along arbitrary, monolithic rank-one directions. Finally, gating limits exposure but does not by itself establish preservation among exposed decisions: it shields the decisions the Router declines, and the evidence here says nothing stronger about the ones it touches. Consequently, mechanistic repair cannot be treated as a static model property, but must be conceptualized as a delicate balance between extraction geometry, injection dosage, and exposure control.
paragraphs.zh: 潜在引导的多维架构。 这些机制研究揭示，表征的可解码性并不必然意味着可因果引导：那些能够以最大线性程度分离错误状态的内部层，未必是干预措施能有效改变下游决策的计算节点。 此外，结果对提取几何结构和注入剂量的敏感性表明，因果引导是在特定的多维子空间中起作用，而非沿着任意、单一的秩一方向进行。 最后，门控机制虽能限制暴露，但本身并不能确保已暴露决策的保留：它仅保护了路由器拒绝的决策，而现有证据并未对其所接触的决策作出更明确的说明。 因此，机制层面的修复不能被视为静态的模型属性，而必须被理解为提取几何结构、注入剂量和暴露控制之间的一种微妙平衡。

paragraphs.en: Systematic Stage-Wise Attrition Across Model Architectures. Mapping the complete empirical evaluation across SAKIKO ’s staged hierarchy demonstrates progressive attrition, wherein individual model configurations fail at distinct, predictable criteria (Table 5 ). In the historical cohort, Llama-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B fail the foundational specificity controls, failing to differentiate from budget-matched random vectors. Moving higher in the hierarchy, Phi-3.5-mini clears destination correctness ( TH c = 0.699 \mathrm{TH}_{c}=0.699 ) but fails preservation by corrupting 52 baseline-correct decisions, while Qwen2.5-7B exhibits high net gain ( + 79 +79 ) but lacks row-level destination logging. In the sealed prospective cohort, Qwen3-4B and Gemma-2-9B satisfy point thresholds for correctability and preservation, but fail the licensing stage due to inconclusive uncertainty intervals crossing null boundaries. Ultimately, only Qwen3-8B successfully navigates the entire five-stage pipeline, clearing all structural, empirical, and statistical thresholds to earn an ADMIT verdict. The historical stops carry no formal verdict: the gate was written afterwards and was never run on them.
paragraphs.zh: 模型架构中的系统性分阶段淘汰。 对 SAKIKO 分阶段层级体系进行全面经验性评估的映射显示，存在逐步淘汰的现象：各模型配置会在不同且可预测的标准上失败（表 5）。 在历史队列中，Llama-3.1-8B 和 Mistral-7B 未能通过基础特异性控制测试，无法与预算相当的随机向量区分开来。 向上进入更高层级时，Phi-3.5-mini 通过了目标正确性测试（TH c = 0.699 \mathrm{TH}_{c}=0.699），但因破坏了 52 个基准正确的决策而未能通过保留性测试；而 Qwen2.5-7B 虽然表现出较高的净增益（+79 +79），却缺乏行级目标日志记录功能。 在封闭的前瞻队列中，Qwen3-4B 和 Gemma-2-9B 满足了可纠正性和保留性的点阈值要求，但由于不确定性区间跨越了零边界且结论不明确，未能通过许可阶段测试。 最终，只有 Qwen3-8B 成功通过了全部五个阶段的流程，满足所有结构、经验和统计阈值，从而获得了“通过”的判定结果。 历史队列中的模型并未获得正式判定：该评估标准是后来制定的，从未在这些模型上运行过。

paragraphs.en: Enforcing the Boundary Between Behavioral Steering and Verified Repair. This progressive attrition shows that behavioral movement, destination-resolved correction, clean-state preservation, and statistical certitude do not inherently coincide in the settings we evaluate. Standard steering literature routinely conflates these levels, claiming repair whenever an internal intervention yields positive aggregate deltas or forces an agent out of an error state. By establishing an evidence pipeline where each verification stage addresses independent failure modes, SAKIKO exposes how aggregate gains can conceal lateral error redistribution, collateral damage, and finite-sample uncertainty. Formalizing this staged adjudication transforms internal representation interventions from ad-hoc activation steering into a rigorous, verifiable methodology for agentic repair.
paragraphs.zh: 在行为引导与验证修复之间确立边界。 这种渐进式的损耗表明，在我们评估的设定中，行为移动、目标导向的修正、纯净状态的保持以及统计上的确定性并非本质上相互一致。 标准的引导文献通常将这些层次混为一谈，认为只要内部干预产生了积极的总体增量，或使智能体脱离错误状态，就构成了修复。 通过建立一个证据流程，其中每个验证阶段都针对独立的故障模式，SAKIKO揭示了总体增益如何可能掩盖横向的错误再分配、附带损害以及有限样本的不确定性。 将这种分阶段的裁决过程形式化，能够将内部表示的干预从临时的激活引导转变为一种严谨且可验证的智能体修复方法。

paragraphs.en: The preregistration is not only a list of thresholds. It fixes, before any evaluation access, the primary statistic, the ten-condition conjunction, an ordered secondary hierarchy that is explicitly non-promotable, the fourteen-step execution order, the bootstrap method and its derived seed, the support rule, thirteen named VOID conditions, and a set of interpretation rules that map each possible outcome onto what may be claimed from it. Three of those provisions do work that a post-hoc reader cannot replicate. The conjunction may not be replaced with a best-looking subset after execution. Secondary results may not rescue a failed primary. And the interpretation rules bind in both directions: the frozen rule for the case in which the score-space comparator matches or exceeds the activation arm states that no claim may then be made that activation intervention provides behaviour unavailable to a frozen score shift. K = 59 K=59 was fixed from a compute-cost table over K ∈ { 39 , 59 , 79 } K\in\{39,59,79\} and declared independent of development rankings, effect sizes, anticipated p p -value and random geometry. The runner reads every frozen quantity from committed artifacts at run time rather than restating it in code, and the raw record schema retains the achieved perturbation norm alongside the intended one, so a drift between specification and execution would be visible in the records rather than silent.
paragraphs.zh: 预注册不仅是一份阈值列表。 它在任何评估访问之前，就确定了主要统计量、十条件联合检验、一个明确不可提升的有序次要层级、十四步执行顺序、自助法及其派生种子、支持规则、十三个名为 VOID 的条件，以及一套解释规则，该规则将每种可能的结果映射到可据此提出的主张。 这些条款中有三项涉及事后读者无法复现的操作。 执行之后，该联合检验不得被替换为看似更优的子集。 次要结果不能挽救失败的主要结果。 此外，解释规则在两个方向上均具有约束力：当得分空间比较器匹配或超过激活臂时，固定的规则规定，此时不得提出任何主张，称激活干预提供了固定得分偏移无法实现的行为。 K = 59（K=59）是从计算成本表（K ∈ {39, 59, 79}）中确定的，并被声明为独立于开发排名、效应量、预期的 p 值以及随机几何结构。 运行程序在运行时从已提交的工件中读取每个固定值，而不是在代码中重新声明它；原始记录方案则同时保留实际实现的扰动范数与预期值，因此规格与执行之间的任何偏差都会在记录中显现，而非悄无声息地发生。

paragraphs.en: The channel, estimator and dose were chosen before sealing, on development data, and every sealed result conditions on that disclosed selection. This is legitimate and it is not blind; we state it rather than present the sealed evaluation as if the configuration had been arbitrary.
paragraphs.zh: 在密封之前，基于开发数据选择了通道、估计器和剂量，并且所有密封结果都以这种公开的选择为条件。 这是合理的，而不是盲目的；我们明确说明这一点，而不是将密封评估呈现得仿佛配置是随意决定的。

paragraphs.en: The frozen disclosure names the criteria and the rejected alternatives. The adjudicated channel was retained because it cleared the support, Router, geometric and dose gates, and because its collateral bound is a real constraint rather than a formality: 368 368 development rows are both routed-eligible and baseline-correct. Two other eligible channels were excluded before sealing and neither is reported as confirmatory afterwards, which would be selection after the fact. One, cannot_answer → \rightarrow direct , was excluded because its collateral rate is structurally zero — the pinned split contains no gold direct rows, so no routed row can ever be baseline-correct and its safety gate carries no information. The other, request_for_info → \rightarrow tool_call , ranked the two interventions in the opposite order on development data and was set aside on that basis. The single confirmatory channel is therefore chosen on development evidence that includes how the two compare, so the sealed run establishes destination-correct repair on the channel it adjudicates and is not a general ranking of activation intervention against a frozen score shift. That is the claim the paper makes, and the disclosure is what keeps it that size.
paragraphs.zh: 该冻结披露文件列出了评判标准以及被拒绝的替代方案。 经裁定通过的通道得以保留，因为它通过了支持性、路由器、几何和剂量门控的检验，并且其附带约束是真正的限制条件而非形式上的要求：368 个开发行既符合路由资格，也满足基准正确性要求。 另外两个符合条件的通道在封存前被排除在外，之后也没有任何通道被报告为确认性通道，否则这将属于事后选择。 其中一个通道（cannot_answer → \rightarrow direct）因附带比率在结构上为零而被排除——固定分割中不包含任何黄金直接行，因此任何路由行都无法满足基准正确性要求，其安全门控也毫无信息价值。 另一个通道（request_for_info → \rightarrow tool_call）在开发数据中对两种干预措施的排序恰好相反，因此基于这一原因被搁置。 因此，唯一的确认性通道是根据开发证据选定的，这些证据包含了对两种措施的比较；由此，封存运行在该通道上确立了目标正确的修复效果，而非对激活干预措施与冻结分数偏移进行的一般性排名。 这正是该论文提出的主张，而披露文件则确保了其规模维持在如此程度。

paragraphs.en: The one-shot ledgers record what a restart was permitted to be. On Qwen3-4B a mechanical VOID for incomplete all-arm execution was followed by exactly one authorised restart, and the ledger states its terms: every arm re-executed from scratch, no resume from partial records, and the voided attempt retained by its identifier. Its gate-only pass is recorded as 25 / 25 25/25 checks against the frozen specification before any sealed row was read. One mechanical incident is recorded in the Gemma formal freeze and its pre-repair runner is retained alongside the incident note. Three pre-access gate repairs and one mechanical VOID occurred, all before any endpoint was observed, and all are disclosed with before-and-after hashes.
paragraphs.zh: 单次记录簿记载了重启被允许的内容。 在 Qwen3-4B 上，一次因所有分支执行不完整而触发的机械性 VOID 之后，恰好有一次授权的重启；记录簿中列明了其条款：每个分支均从头重新执行，不得从部分记录中恢复，且被作废的尝试通过其标识符保留。 其仅通过门控的测试记录为 25 / 25，在读取任何密封行之前，已对冻结规范完成了 25/25 项检查。 Gemma 的正式冻结状态中记录了一次机械性事件，其修复前的运行实例与事件说明一并保留。 发生了三次访问前的门控修复和一次机械性 VOID，所有事件均在任何端点被观察到之前发生，且全部通过前后哈希值进行了披露。

paragraphs.en: An eighth model was evaluated and never reached the intervention stage. On every naive indicator it was the most promising setting in the panel — the highest baseline accuracy ( 0.4533 0.4533 ), the least collapse onto a single predicted class, and errors lying closest to the decision boundary. Its accuracy gain is unevenly distributed across gold classes: recall on a follow-up question roughly doubles relative to the other models ( 0.326 0.326 against 0.170 0.170 and 0.132 0.132 ) while recall on a refusal falls to the lowest in the panel ( 0.087 0.087 ). Because reference and error rows within a gold class compete for a fixed number of items, that redistribution starves the reference side of every refusal channel — including the exact channel carrying the sealed evaluations — leaving 29 29 reference rows against a frozen minimum of 30 30 , and enriches the one channel that three models already agree is not linearly readable at the observation site. The sealed population was never opened. The stop is split-sensitive: under 30 30 retrospective group-preserving reallocations the refusal channels were eligible in 56.7 % 56.7\% of them, against a median achievable support of 34 34 .
paragraphs.zh: 第八个模型经过评估，但从未进入干预阶段。 在所有初始指标上，它都是该组中最有前景的设置——基线准确率最高（0.4533），向单一预测类别的坍缩程度最低，且错误分布最接近决策边界。 其准确率提升在不同金标准类别中的分布并不均匀：在后续问题上的召回率相较于其他模型几乎翻倍（0.326 对比 0.170 和 0.132），而在拒绝情况下的召回率则降至该组最低（0.087）。 由于金标准类别内参考行与错误行需争夺固定数量的条目，这种重新分配导致每个拒绝通道都缺乏参考数据——包括承载密封评估的精确通道——最终留下 29 个参考行，而最低固定数量则为 30；同时，这也强化了那个三个模型均已一致认为在观测点无法线性读取的通道。 密封样本集从未被打开。 停止机制对分割敏感：在少于 30 次的回顾性群体保留重新分配中，拒绝通道在 56.7% 的情况下是符合条件的，而可达到的支持率中位数为 34。

paragraphs.en: No setting in this paper attains exposure-conditional preservation certification. Qwen3-8B’s 0 / 6 0/6 gives an upper bound of 0.3930 0.3930 ; Gemma-2-9B’s 1 / 11 1/11 gives 0.3644 0.3644 ; Qwen3-4B’s 1 / 50 1/50 gives 0.0914 0.0914 ; Phi-3.5’s 52 / 93 52/93 gives 0.6468 0.6468 . The paper reports that none attains it, which is a true statement fully supported by the data, and does not claim preservation certification anywhere.
paragraphs.zh: 本文中的任何设置均未达到条件曝光保持认证。 Qwen3-8B的0 / 6 0/6给出的上限为0.3930 0.3930；Gemma-2-9B的1 / 11 1/11给出的值为0.3644 0.3644；Qwen3-4B的1 / 50 1/50给出的值为0.0914 0.0914；Phi-3.5的52 / 93 52/93给出的值为0.6468 0.6468。 该论文报告称没有任何设置达到这一认证，这是一个完全由数据支持的真实陈述，且文中任何地方均未声称获得了保持认证。

paragraphs.en: Table 16 gives the artifact location for every result in the paper. The formal Qwen3-8B run is reproduced by python scripts/qwen3_stage2_formal.py --run-formal under protocol version QWEN3_STAGE2_FORMAL_V1 , guarded by an approval environment variable; the configuration check is --gate-only and runs without opening the evaluation payload. Determinism controls are greedy decoding, batch size 1 1 , fixed arm order, fixed sample order, a single process and a single model load, with no checkpointing or resume between scientific arms.
paragraphs.zh: 表 16 给出了论文中每个结果的产物位置。 正式的 Qwen3-8B 运行通过 python scripts/qwen3_stage2_formal.py --run-formal 在协议版本 QWEN3_STAGE2_FORMAL_V1 下重现，并由一个审批环境变量进行保护；配置检查为 --gate-only，且在不打开评估负载的情况下运行。 确定性控制包括贪心解码、批量大小为 1 1、固定的臂顺序、固定的样本顺序、单个进程和单次模型加载，并且在科学臂之间没有检查点或恢复操作。

paragraphs.en: All *.jsonl , *.npz and *.npy artifacts are tracked with Git LFS. A checkout without git lfs pull yields pointer files of approximately 132 132 bytes that read as empty rather than failing, so any reproduction attempt should verify artifact sizes before interpreting an empty result.
paragraphs.zh: 所有 *.jsonl、*.npz 和 *.npy 文件都通过 Git LFS 进行版本控制。 如果不执行 git lfs pull，检出时会产生约 132132 字节的指针文件，这些文件显示为空而非报错，因此任何复现尝试都应在解释空结果之前验证文件的大小。
